answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. By the garden of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The quartz holds work receipts rather than names, so the spiral of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
